verdict.rationale: BILL's developer docs describe subscribing to real-time webhook notifications that explicitly cover Spend & Expense events, alongside AP and AR. The docs also cover HMAC-SHA256 signing with a securityKey for verifying notifications, webhook payload pages, and S&E-specific webhook error responses. Subscriptions are capped at 10 per organization. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of S&E webhook delivery.
